decisions.reason: The quoted sentence explicitly lists Gaucher disease as one of the storage diseases included within progressive myoclonic epilepsies (PMEs). The sentence structure 'They include storage diseases like Gaucher disease...' directly establishes the association between Gaucher disease and PMEs.

The quoted sentence explicitly lists Lafora disease as one of the storage diseases included within progressive myoclonic epilepsies (PMEs).
